title: Symmetry of binomial ratios
statement: For natural numbers $m,p,q$ satisfying $p+q=m$, the following identity holds in the real numbers: $\binom mq/\binom{2m}{2q}=\binom mp/\binom{2m}{2p}$.
replaced:
For all $m,p,q\in\mathbb N$ with $p+q=m$, the binomial coefficients satisfy the real identity
\[
 \frac{\binom mq}{\binom{2m}{2q}}
 =\frac{\binom mp}{\binom{2m}{2p}}.
\]
